page.overview:
What is Khalid al-Munir?

Khalid al-Munir is a powerful Assamite of the Sorcerer Caste.

The blood magic Sihr was a creation of Khalid al-Munir and Tarique al-Hajj, who supposedly studied with Ahl-i-Batin mages to erect the wards that contain the Keening. They taught it to their progeny and disciples and even in the Final Nights, the Hajj practice Sihr. Outside the bloodline, however, it has fallen out of use, being replaced by the more versatile Thaumaturgy or incorporated into Assamite Sorcery.
